name: Awakening: continuing without choosing a System is refused

planSteps.description: Open the app at / and wait up to 30 seconds for the '[ SYSTEM ]' window to appear (a Flutter web app; it can take a while to load, and controls are exposed in the accessibility tree)
Click 'CONFIRM SYSTEM' without clicking any System card
The error text 'Choose a System.' is shown and the '[ CHOOSE YOUR SYSTEM ]' window is still displayed (no '[ PLACEMENT TEST ]' window)
